data.text: Dr Priya Patel in the respiratory clinic was absolutely wonderful. She took time to explain my COPD management plan and made sure I understood every step. The nurse on reception, Karen Thompson, was also very welcoming.
The parking at 45 Albert Street is very limited. I had to walk from the Westfield car park which is difficult at my age.

I had my appointment on 15 January 2026 at 2pm and wasn't seen until after 3:15pm. Dr James Richardson seemed rushed and didn't listen to my concerns about the medication side effects. I called the clinic at 07 3456 7890 twice before my appointment to ask about preparation and nobody answered. My wife Angela Chen had a much better experience at the Chermside Day Surgery last month.

The physiotherapist Michael was great. He gave me a detailed home exercise program after my knee surgery and followed up via email at susan.obrien82@gmail.com to check on my progress. Very impressed with that level of care.

The online booking system could be easier to use. I ended up calling reception to book because I couldn't figure out the Zedoc portal. I was referred by Dr Nguyen at the Ipswich Hospital and the transition was smooth.

Nurse Rebecca Taylor in the diabetes clinic was exceptional. She spent over 40 minutes with me going through my HbA1c results and adjusting my insulin plan. She also coordinated with my GP Dr Samantha Lee at the Toowoomba Medical Practice to ensure consistent care.
Dr Patel is always thorough and patient. She remembers details from previous visits which makes me feel valued.

I'm 81 years old and find the forms quite difficult to fill in. My daughter Sarah Fitzpatrick usually helps me but she wasn't available this time. Could you offer some assistance at the front desk for elderly patients? Also my Medicare number is 2345 67890 1 and I think there was a billing error on my last visit on 28 January 2026.
The midwifery team, especially Lisa and Jenny, were amazing throughout my pregnancy. They made me feel safe and supported. The antenatal classes at the centre on George Street were also excellent.

It would be nice to have later appointment slots. As a working mum I find it hard to attend before 4pm. My employer at Bright Horizons Childcare is not always flexible with time off. I recommended this clinic to my sister-in-law Patricia Nakamura who is expecting in July.
The new blood collection nurse, Daniel Kim, was very skilled. Best blood draw I've had - barely felt it. He mentioned he previously worked at the Royal Brisbane and Women's Hospital.
The results portal is confusing. I had to call Dr Richardson's office at 07 3456 7891 to get my pathology explained because I couldn't understand the online report.
Dr Patel and Nurse Rebecca were both excellent. They were respectful of my cultural needs and ensured a female practitioner was available for my examination. This was very important to me.

The interpreter service was not available on 4 March 2026 when my mother attended. She speaks Arabic and struggled to communicate her symptoms. Please ensure interpreters are booked in advance. My mother Zahra Al-Rashid (patient ID PAT-91603) would like to provide feedback separately. Can someone contact her at fatima.alrashid@outlook.com to arrange an Arabic-language survey?

Outstanding mental health support from psychologist Dr Amanda Clarke. She helped me develop coping strategies after my workplace incident at BHP Mitsubishi Alliance in Mount Isa last year. The telehealth option made it possible to continue sessions when I was FIFO.
The mental health waiting list is too long. I was referred on 15 November 2025 and didn't get my first appointment until 8 January 2026. That's nearly 8 weeks.
The wound care nurse Jacinta was thorough and gentle. She explained the healing process for my post-surgical wound clearly and gave me written instructions to take home.

I received a reminder SMS from Zedoc to complete this survey but the link didn't work on my Samsung phone. I had to use my husband David Tran's iPhone instead. The SMS came from number 0437 123 456. I was transferred from Logan Hospital after my surgery there on 2 March 2026. The handover between hospitals could have been smoother - my medication list wasn't updated correctly.

The entire cardiology team is first-rate. Dr Richardson personally called me at home on 0478 234 567 to discuss my stress test results. That kind of proactive communication is rare and very reassuring.

The car park needs more disabled bays. I have a temporary mobility permit after my cardiac rehab and struggled to find a spot on 20 March 2026. My cardiologist at the Prince Charles Hospital, Dr Andrew Walsh, also coordinates with Dr Richardson here which gives me great confidence in my care plan.

I was diagnosed with early-stage breast cancer in February 2026 and the oncology team led by Dr Helen Nguyen has been outstanding. She called me personally on 0412 876 543 after my biopsy results to explain the next steps calmly and clearly. My treatment plan was emailed to me at margaret.oconnor1954@bigpond.com the same day. The cancer care coordinator, Theresa Vong, has been an incredible support throughout this journey.

My teenage son Lachlan Whitfield (DOB 14 June 2009) was brought to the emergency department on 7 April 2026 after a football injury at Coorparoo Raiders. The triage wait was over two hours before he was seen. When Dr Singh finally examined him he was thorough, but the initial wait was distressing. Please staff the ED more adequately on weekend afternoons.

The orthopaedic surgeon Dr Matthew Croft performed my right hip replacement on 3 February 2026 and the outcome has been excellent. The pre-admission clinic nurse, Deborah Hartley, called me at 07 3311 9820 two days before surgery to run through the consent process which I really appreciated. The only issue was the discharge paperwork which referred to my left hip - please double-check documentation before sending patients home.

As someone with Multiple Sclerosis I rely heavily on continuity of care. My neurologist Dr Farid Hosseini at the Neurosciences Clinic has managed my condition brilliantly since 2022. My NDIS plan coordinator Wendy Brookes at Inclusion Solutions on 07 3876 2200 liaises directly with his team which makes everything so much smoother. I had an MRI on 22 April 2026 and results were uploaded to MyHealthRecord within 48 hours - very efficient.

The dermatology clinic removed a suspicious mole from my back on 11 March 2026 and the results came back benign. Dr Sofia Papadopoulos was reassuring and professional. However, I noticed my Medicare number 3876 54321 0 was printed incorrectly on my receipt - it showed one digit wrong. Please verify billing records. I can be reached at henry.bartlett@optusnet.com.au if you need to correct anything.

I was referred to the urology department by my GP Dr Kenneth Marsh at Sunnybank Hills Family Practice on 9 January 2026. I am still waiting for an appointment as of today. The referral was marked urgent due to haematuria but I have heard nothing. I called 07 3240 6600 three times and was placed on hold each time. My name is Victor Papadimitriou and my date of birth is 23 September 1948. This delay is causing me significant anxiety.

The paediatric physiotherapy team was wonderful with our daughter Isabelle Mortimer who is four years old and has cerebral palsy. Therapist Grace Ngo designed a fun, age-appropriate program and our daughter actually looks forward to her sessions every Thursday at 10am. We were connected with the Early Childhood Early Intervention team at Stafford through Grace's recommendation, and that referral has made a huge difference to our family. Thank you from both myself and my husband Tom Mortimer.

I am 76 years old and attended the continence clinic on 18 February 2026. The nurse Margaret Skelton was kind and patient. She sent follow-up resources to my son's email address, christopher.skelton@gmail.com, since I do not use the internet myself. I live alone at 12 Coronation Drive, Nundah QLD 4012 and rely on public transport so the clinic's proximity to the Nundah train station is very helpful. Please keep the accessible toilet on the ground floor unlocked during clinic hours.

The radiology department is exceptionally well run. I had a CT scan on 2 May 2026 and was seen exactly on time. Radiographer Jake Thornton explained every step of the procedure and made me feel at ease. The images were sent electronically to my referring GP Dr Aisha Okafor at Clayfield Medical Centre the same afternoon. I would also mention that the online check-in kiosk was quick and intuitive - much better than filling in paper forms.

The occupational therapist Sandra Yuen completed a home assessment at my property at 88 Rode Road, Wavell Heights on 14 April 2026 and arranged for several modifications including grab rails and a shower seat. I am recovering from a stroke I had on 6 March 2026 and Sandra's practical support has been invaluable. She coordinated equipment delivery with my NDIS support coordinator Brian Leung at Able Future Services, phone 0401 558 772. I cannot speak highly enough of this level of integrated care.

I recently moved from New Zealand and was uncertain how my Southern Cross Health Insurance would apply here. The patient liaison officer Renata Flores spent considerable time on 27 March 2026 helping me understand what was covered and contacted my insurer on my behalf. My membership number with Southern Cross is SC-449827-NZ. Dr Joanna Lim in the ophthalmology clinic diagnosed my early glaucoma and arranged a follow-up for 9 June 2026. The whole experience from reception to specialist was seamless.

I began treatment for Crohn's disease under gastroenterologist Dr Paul Brennan in November 2025 and my condition has improved significantly since starting biologics in January 2026. One concern: my infusion appointment on 30 April 2026 was cancelled with only three hours notice by SMS from 0488 900 123. Rescheduling required me to take an additional day off work at Queensland Rail, which is not always possible on short notice. Could the clinic provide at least 48 hours notice for cancellations?

I attended the BreastScreen Queensland mobile clinic that visited Carindale on 8 April 2026. The entire process was smooth and the radiographer Patrice Delacroix was professional and respectful. Results were posted to my home address at 3 Banksia Court, Carindale QLD 4152 within ten days as promised. I'm 54 years old and this was my third screening. My GP Dr Michelle Tan at Carindale Family Health on 07 3398 7700 also received a copy of the results, which I appreciated for continuity of my health records.
